## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green (build, tests, formatting, security scans).
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests.
- [ ] Money stays exact (`long`) and dates are calendar dates where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or `.env` values are committed.
- [ ] Docs (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/`) updated if behavior or conventions changed.
- [ ] Changes are focused and reasonably small.
